title: Knowledge Combination Analysis
note: Analysis of how combining knowledge signals affects predictive power

combination_above20dma_AND_volume_ratio.note: From Model D simulation — requires both above_20dma=1 AND volume_ratio > 2.0
combination_above20dma_AND_volume_ratio.finding: Adding above_20dma filter to volume ranking REDUCES precision vs pure volume model. Suggests adding a second binary gate when volume is already strong reduces recall without improving precision.

model_B_signal_births.note: Data gap — signal_births not linked to market_leader detection set

technical_plus_macro.confidence_uplift: +0.68 points for debate-approved vs raw signals
technical_plus_macro.note: Cannot isolate macro contribution from other debate agents

technical_plus_sector.finding: sector_strength=0.5 (default) in all ml_performance_dataset rows — sector filtering not active or not varying. Cannot evaluate from available data.
technical_plus_sector.recommendation: Sector alignment should be Layer 3 filter, not just debate agent input

full_debate_combination.signal: Technical + macro + risk + sentiment + regime (5 agents)
full_debate_combination.finding: Full debate combination provides meaningful signal discrimination but requires signal to pass strategy gate first

signal_decay_analysis.finding: The knowledge-based momentum signal has meaningful edge on day 1 (0.30% avg, 50.7% vs 48.4% positive rate) but this edge is essentially gone by day 3 and reverses at day 5. The system targets 3-5 day holds. This is the CORE MISMATCH between knowledge signal decay and strategy hold period.

sector_alignment_gap.detail: The equity scanner generates signals based on RSI/volume/DMA without checking sector direction. A stock in a headwind sector can satisfy all technical criteria and generate a signal. Sector strength enters at Layer 5 (debate) as a macro input but by then the signal has already been through strategy gate.
sector_alignment_gap.evidence: Today's blocked signals: 14 of 28 (50%) were grade D — stock moved against signal direction. Grade D signals include TATASTEEL (-1.75% vs LONG signal), PAGEIND (-2.70% vs LONG signal). Both are in sectors with headwinds (metals, FMCG discretionary).
sector_alignment_gap.improvement_lever: Add sector_momentum check to Layer 3 scanner — only generate LONG signals for stocks in sectors with positive sector_momentum > 0.0

time_horizon_mismatch_analysis.conclusion: Current knowledge signals are optimized for same-day detection. The strategy targets require sustained multi-day momentum. These are misaligned. Either signals need to use longer-term indicators or holding periods need to be shortened to capture intraday momentum.

data_support.interpretation: At day 5, controls (non-leader stocks) have HIGHER positive rate than leaders — the momentum edge has not only faded but briefly reversed
